scope: all eligible USER frames with causal dialogue context and known current service schema

nodes.name: Freeze workflow contract
nodes.note: All-turn causal input and 98%/95% gates frozen before contextual scoring; NONE is an automated no-route outcome, distinct from defer.

nodes.name: Dataset provenance
nodes.note: Official checkout pinned to e852981ae34990f4358979625854259302feaa78; source files hashed.

nodes.name: Label-quality audit
nodes.note: All-turn collisions, class diversity, NONE and transitions measured; human disagreement and semantic ambiguity unmeasured.

nodes.name: Whole-service held-out split
nodes.note: 22 train, 7 dev-only validation, 9 test-only sealed services; test dialogue contents unopened.

nodes.name: Candidate-access ceiling
nodes.note: Two to four official intents per selected service; full scoring yields 100% candidate access for active intents.

nodes.name: Full candidate scoring baseline
nodes.note: Initial-turn 82.2% is diagnostic only; matched all-turn contextual baselines running on 10,905 decisions.

nodes.name: Current K8 control
nodes.note: Current served router chooses packed Choice at <=19 candidates; K8 retrieval is not invoked for 2-4 candidates.

nodes.name: Larger-K baseline
nodes.note: K8, K16, K32 and all produce the same candidate set at <=4 candidates.

nodes.name: Strong retriever candidate
nodes.note: No retrieval ceiling exists in this frozen workflow.

nodes.name: Late-interaction candidate
nodes.note: Cannot improve candidate access beyond 100%; would add latency.

nodes.name: Candidate-access architecture
nodes.note: All-candidate scoring has 100% candidate access for active intents; no retrieval required at 2-4 schema intents. Select after matched contextual baseline.

nodes.name: Scorer optimization
nodes.note: Only train on official train services after label audit is sufficient.

nodes.name: Calibration
nodes.note: Requires separate service-disjoint calibration allocation; never use sealed test.

nodes.name: Selective deferral
nodes.note: Fit coverage/risk policy and confidence intervals.

nodes.name: Robustness
nodes.note: Noise, length, paraphrase, field order, and schema variants.

nodes.name: Latency and cost
nodes.note: Requires named production hardware and dated price source.

nodes.name: Freeze finalist
nodes.note: Bind source, taxonomy, model, calibration, threshold and runtime hashes.

nodes.name: Sealed test
nodes.note: Open official test-only service dialogues exactly once, after finalist freeze.

nodes.name: Commercial decision
nodes.note: Public SGD can pass a research quality gate only; paid pilot also needs customer and license evidence.
